Module ru.ashemchuk.task_2_3_1
Package ru.ashemchuk.model.snake

Class RobotSnake

java.lang.Object
ru.ashemchuk.model.snake.Snake
ru.ashemchuk.model.snake.RobotSnake
Direct Known Subclasses:
FollowPlayerRobot, RandomRobot
public abstract class RobotSnake extends Snake
Abstract base class for robot-controlled snakes. Provides common logic for movement, wall avoidance, eating, and death. Subclasses must implement decideDirection() to define AI behavior.
